item1_mechanism.name: Committed-capital book-turnover premium
item1_mechanism.statement: The ratio of traded volume to open interest (book turnover) measures how many days of average trading are needed to rotate the standing position stock. High volume relative to the OI stock means price discovery is dominated by short-horizon flow (intraday leverage churn, scalping) whose holding horizon ends within hours; market-making inventory turns fast with high adverse selection and the standing OI stock provides little committed two-sided interest. Low churn means the book is dominated by committed capital that has absorbed its entry impact and does not face self-unwinding pressure, providing standing depth for liquidity providers.
item1_mechanism.economic_counterparty: short-horizon liquidity demanders (perp scalpers, intraday leverage) versus committed position holders and the market makers financing inventory against the standing stock
item1_mechanism.why_edge_exists: holding-horizon composition is a persistent 28d-scale structural property; futures risk premia carry a positioning-structure component distinct from systematic beta (Bessembinder 1992; De Roon-Nijman-Veld 2000)
item1_mechanism.expected_sign: the 5 symbols with the LOWEST 28d book turnover outperform the cross-section mean and BTC buy-and-hold after costs (long-only selection premium)

drop-one vacuous or family verdict flips under drop-one

item5_universe_clock_execution.universe: 20 frozen required symbols minus BTCUSDT = 19 tradable USD-M perpetuals; BTCUSDT benchmark/context only
item5_universe_clock_execution.eligibility_per_stamp: complete trailing 28d (anchor) / 56d (neighbour) of completed 15m bars AND >= 26 (>= 52) daily OI snapshots with stamps <= T; ineligible symbols excluded that stamp; book renormalizes across eligible names at equal weight 1/N; N >= 4 satisfies |w| <= 0.30 by construction (1/4 = 0.25); N < 4 scales gross down to keep |w| <= 0.30 at every stamp
item5_universe_clock_execution.warmup: binding 90d (BTC-beta context) per frozen warmup table (anchor_28d, neighbour_56d, beta_90d, binding_max 90); satisfied from authorized pre-screen history 2024-08-20..2025-08-22
item5_universe_clock_execution.decision_clock: every Monday 00:00:00:00Z (weekly-or-slower; 52/365d <= 60 frozen floor); book carried between stamps; forced-flat only at fold boundaries
item5_universe_clock_execution.folds: F0/F1/F2 chronological over blind-S0 window 2025-08-22..2026-08-21 with frozen 1-day purge; first stamp of each fold strictly after the purge boundary
item5_universe_clock_execution.execution_lag_declared_single: fill at the close of the first completed 15m bar with close time STRICTLY AFTER the decision stamp = Monday 00:15:00Z; stress adds +1 event delay = Monday 00:30:00Z
item5_universe_clock_execution.holding: 7d intended (weekly cadence; >= 3d median floor); full target-book rebalance at stamps only

anchor.construction: rank 19 eligible symbols ascending on book_turnover_28d; long the 5 lowest at 0.20 each, gross 1.0

neighbour.justification: positioning-regime persistence is multi-scale; 56d further dilutes OI reporting noise (Giagkiozis-Said caveat); stays inside the frozen warmup table (neighbour_56d)

causal_negative_control.construction: identical pipeline; ranking on log 28d mean daily dollar-volume LEVEL alone (OI denominator removed); long the 5 lowest-volume names
causal_negative_control.rival_explanation_tested: the edge is just avoiding big/active (size-liquidity) names, not positioning-relative churn
causal_negative_control.preregistered_rule_control_must_not_repr: control reproduction := VOLLEVEL-28D passes after-cost expectancy > 0 AND its per-fold buy-and-hold-excess signs match the anchor's in >= 2/3 folds; if reproduction occurs the causal attribution FAILS and CAPVEL is INELIGIBLE for selection even if the anchor passes every Stage-A gate

item7_incremental_test.buy_and_hold_benchmark: BTCUSDT buy-and-hold at matched gross from the same authorized bars under the same fusion availability stamps; per-fold weekly excess
item7_incremental_test.btc_beta_context: trailing 90d daily beta of the arm vs BTC (authorized bars, PIT stamps; frozen beta_90d warmup); beta-adjusted excess per fold
item7_incremental_test.gate_frozen: BOTH excess measures positive in >= 2/3 folds; raw-pass + beta-context-fail means BTC beta in disguise -> REJECT

item8_costs_floors_concentration_dropone.base_costs: generic adapter fee + slippage on fills only; native funding settlements while held enter exactly once as a COST
item8_costs_floors_concentration_dropone.stress: fee x1.5, +2 adverse ticks (instrument tick sizes), +1 event delay
item8_costs_floors_concentration_dropone.concentration: largest-symbol positive-PnL share <= 0.70 enforced as the frozen Stage-A gate; equal-weight quintile construction bounds per-swap notional at 0.20 of gross; residual single-symbol turnover-share risk is DETECTED by the frozen feasibility floor, never relaxed
item8_costs_floors_concentration_dropone.sample_floors: 52 scheduled stamps/yr; frozen minimum-activity convention (zero-position baseline refused at publication); a stamp with fewer than 4 eligible symbols carries the book unchanged and is still counted
item8_costs_floors_concentration_dropone.drop_one: at each decision stamp the perturbed schedule drops the single HELD symbol with MAXIMUM |weight| for that holding span; flat book = VACUOUS; gates require non-vacuous drop-one symbol survival AND fold survival (dropping any single fold must not flip the family verdict)
